stations.title: Bryn
stations.say: Why does OK-2052 cost the top price?
stations.note: A light parcel of two tins.

stations.title: Packing
stations.text: Its own copy of an order, kept up to date.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Each file has its own order

stations.title: Shipping
stations.text: Its copy still reads a weight nobody sends.

captions: Bryn asks why order OK-2052, two small tins, costs the top shipping price.
Packing and shipping each keep a copy of an order, and shipping's copy is out of date.
You write the type of an order once, in order.ts, and both files import it as a type.
Shipping now reads the weight the form sends, and OK-2052 ships as a light parcel.
One type of an order, shared by every file, so the copies can no longer drift.
